name: Disruptive Touch
body:
Discipline: psychometabolism; Level Vitalist 0

MANIFESTING

Display Auditory
Manifesting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range Touch
Target One living creature touched
Duration 3 rounds
Saving Throw Fort negates; Power Resistance yes
Power Points: psionic focus or 1

DESCRIPTION

Your touch disrupts the natural energy of the creature’s body, causing them to be staggered unless they make a successful Fortitude save.
